Model × Dataset

One row per iteration (34 solutions in 2 families; the 30 ablations are in the With ablations view), one column per dev task of ur5e_alone › workspace/v2, grouped by task kind (42 tasks). A cell is that task's tool_track_rms_mm from the solution's scorecard.json: the RMS tool error over the samples where the target moves. Click a cell to open its run.

Roll-up, in plain words: a solution's score on a dataset is the median of its per-task numbers (that median is the objective); across datasets of one deployment the score is the plain average of those medians, with every dataset counted once; deployments are never pooled. Ruler v1 has one dataset, so the score is the median of the 42 tasks: the Median of the dataset column, and the Per dataset (median) view. Per dataset (mean) and (mean rank) roll up the same numbers by their mean and by the solution's average rank across the tasks. A family's row and the footer show the median of the rows under them (a column's menu, Calculate, switches it).

How the rows, the rank and the links are made

Family, by lineage: a generation-0 solution (tag gen-0: robot_controllers' P1–P10 configs) is in "generation 0"; an ablation (tag ablation) is in "ablations"; every other solution is in its lineage, named by the generation-0 solution reached by following its parents ("p5s lineage").

Rank on the task: 1 + how many of the solutions (ablations left out) have a lower tool tracking RMS on that task; ties share a rank, an ablation is placed among the solutions, and a failed gate does not change it (the Gates failed view shows those).

Switches: the views are presets of one roll-up level or one metric; in any of them the toolbar's view settings switch the metric (Cell value), the roll-up (Summary: Median, Average, …) and the column levels in place. The left panel filters by family, gates, task kind and kind of iteration. Rows is the plain list behind the grid. A cell opens its run: in the Trajectory Comparison for the solutions saved on every task, in the landing page's player for those saved on one task per kind, else the task's Comparison (its record says which).
